title: Appraisal Order Late-Rush Refund Amount
content:
## Appraisal Order late-rush refund — amount

**Owed.** A late-rush refund is owed on a completed order whose borrower paid a rush charge and whose days late are one or more, and nothing is refunded when the days late are zero or fewer.

**Outside the rule.** A rush charge on a cancelled order, on an order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal, or collected before the borrower's intent to proceed is outside this rule, because the fee refund policy returns it in full. A rush charge is collected before intent to proceed when the date of the rush charge on the order is earlier than the intent-to-proceed date recorded on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports.

**Amount.** The standard late-rush refund returns the rush charge standing on the order in full, the days late being the calendar days from the due date to the completed date. The rush charge standing on the order is the charges on its rush line less any refunds of that line. The refund is the refund share applied once to that rush charge standing. The refund share is built on the full share of 100 percent, which returns the rush charge standing in full. The refund is kept to the cent.

### Worked cases (hypothetical; rush charge of 150.00 collected after intent to proceed, nothing yet refunded on the rush line)

| Order | Due date | Completed date | Days late | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Completed, not cancelled | the 10th | the 13th | 3 | 150.00 |
| Completed, not cancelled | the 10th | the 10th | 0 | 0.00 |
| Completed, not cancelled | the 10th | the 8th | negative | 0.00 |
| Cancelled | — | — | — | Outside this rule |
| HPML flip second appraisal | — | — | — | Outside this rule |

With 50.00 of the rush charge already refunded on the rush line, the rush charge standing is 100.00, and a refund owed at the full share is 100.00.
